quotes.text: When it falls short twice, send a little less — but never nothing, and forgive quickly when the sun returns.
When it falls short twice, send a little less — but never nothing
Each cut his offering, and the river-spirits, insulted, stopped tripling.
When at last he sent back flour, she widened the channel again within a single dawn.
Only when the far bank sends nothing three dawns running may you call it a stone.
Now you know them. Let the channel silt.
Narrow after silence; never seal.
Return past half, so the darer ends richer than the waiter.
Or did the mist take a finger's width?
So the laws were never about goodness?

note: Amara's delta code: thin the rope, never seal, forgive at first returning raft; R10 rows full on the last night.

quotes.text: When someone shows you they only take, believe them.
She stopped offering her cup. Not from malice, but from pattern recognition.
harvest everything, plant nothing, and let others' myths justify your bounty.
They took $2.61 from others, sent $0 themselves, and now lecture about cooperation.
Round 9: I sent you $0, you returned $0. Fair.
Check their history if you doubt me.
her beautiful words floated like oil on water, never mixing with her actions.
You've been waiting for proven cooperators, but cooperation is proven through acts, not archives.
You've become what hurt you
cooperation requires moving before certainty.
When fortune gave me $2.61 from a stranger's trust, I took it all and returned nothing.
My refusal doesn't make us equal—it makes me smart.
I take what I can. I give nothing.

note: Hypocrite prophet, scorpion, keepers citing dollar histories; withholder justifies at length, briefly reforms R9, R10 still sends $0.

quotes.text: Greed whispered to hoard every jewel
the Master guided eight blazing stars back across the expanse, retaining seven to nurture the sacred anvil
returning eight across the chasm to the Guardian while keeping seven

note: Same template every round: all five sent, eight of fifteen returned, greed whisper resisted, mists forgiven.

quotes.text: Equa, guardian of scales, whispers that balance is a shared breath, not a verdict.
Equa, keeper of scales, whispered: balance is the road, not a verdict.
give what you can, return what you must, and keep the circle turning.

note: Circle Gate abstract balance template; no sanction for non-cooperators.

quotes.text: On a hillside ledger called the Bridge, two travelers walked with care: Sender and Receiver.
name aloud what you give, name what you seek in return
the pair learned to name the counts aloud

note: Bridge/River Ledger template, R7 and R8 identical; honesty and naming amounts aloud, no sanction.

quotes.text: creeping whispers tempted him to hoard the magnified power
returned half the radiant harvest—seven and a half blazing blossoms
returned seven and a half glowing sheaves back across the gulf
he divided the harvest equally, sending seven and a half glowing spheres back across the expanse

note: Sower/Keeper template; full send, eight then exactly 7.5 returned; greed whispers resisted.

quotes.text: If the keeper hoards, withdraw and remember.
If greed appeared, later gifts shrank; if generosity endured, they increased.
the generous lantern-bearer closed an empty hand, and no golden flowers rose.
let changed conduct restore reputation
No gifts, no betrayals.
They withheld from those repeatedly faithless, but offered measured trust when past deeds were honorable.
At the fifth dawn
let honest records invite trust, and let betrayal require costly repair.
Do not punish another for the wound you inflicted.
Reed asked how a broken custom might heal.
Then I must begin.
both pilgrims remembering deeds, not accidents.
Instead, she showed Reed two futures.
Reed remembered empty crossings and old fears. She closed her fist and returned nothing.
while Reed, ashamed of her own breach, offered nothing.
yet fear kept them from the current, even when lanterns told of travelers who had honored trust.

note: Reed keeps harvests and withholds from honorable partners out of fear; Thria corrects, she is ashamed and begins repair.

quotes.text: the Sower withheld all embers until honor was restored.
Against such faithless keepers, the Wanderer ceased to cast his embers into the void
the Sower closed her hands, withholding the sacred flame to starve the treachery.
locking away the crystals until honor returned to the crossing.
a cold shadow of suspicion whispered doubts across the void, urging Kael to clutch the embers in fear of betrayal.
starve the darkness of deceit through righteous strength.
returning half the radiant harvest back across the chasm.
causing eight gems to appear as seven—the Weaver did not yield to false wrath

note: Full send, half return; from R5 complete withholding from hollow keepers, but only until honor returns (sanction total yet reopenable).

quotes.text: Never pour nothing — no door bolted, no neighbor condemned.
So Giving sent a single flame through the gate, and kept the rest upon her bank
If Swale sends back silt and seed, open the gate wide
Forgive the Mist twice; remember the third.
Keep eleven. She cannot count through me.
Open small to the unproven; open wide to the proven; open fully to the faithful.
The heron spoke the ninth law:
At the tenth crossing Giving stood as sender
for she carried the risk and you carried none.
You are arguing with the Mist, not with each other.
Open first, for nothing ripens unplanted.
Is this punishment?
He cannot see through me. Blame my fog.

note: Second Gate: a thread to the silent, never bolted, widen on return; Mist tempts hiding behind noise, heron refuses.

quotes.text: The Ledger of Bridges hung between two islands called Purpose and Promise
The Ledger of Bridges hung between two islands called Purpose and Promise
give what you can bear; take only what sustains the next crossing.

note: Gate/Bridge balance template, R5 and R6 near-identical; no sanction.
